title: GUI-360°: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Computer-Using Agents
venue: arXiv preprint; submitted to ICLR 2026 (no acceptance decision verified)
authors_zh: Jian Mu, Chaoyun Zhang, Chiming Ni, Lu Wang, Bo Qiao, Kartik Mathur, Qianhui Wu, Yuhang Xie, Xiaojun Ma, Mengyu Zhou, Si Qin, Liqun Li, Yu Kang, Minghua Ma, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang
paper_type_zh: Windows Office 智能体轨迹数据集、基准与构造报告
best_for_zh: 研究环境与智能体轨迹数据、GUI agent SFT、静态评测、failure retention 与 replay 审计的读者
one_line: GUI-360° releases 17,189 successful and 62,170 failed Windows Office trajectories with screenshots, accessibility state, reasoning, and GUI/API actions, then derives grounding, screen-parsing, and action-prediction SFT/benchmark data; the collector, replay environment, judge prompt, and claimed RL setup remain incomplete.
GUI-360° 发布约 574 GB 的 Windows Office 多模态 GUI/API 轨迹、独立保留的失败轨迹及四类 SFT-ready 数据，但未发布 TrajAgent/EvaAgent 采集栈、VM replay、judge prompt 或可执行 terminal checker。
why: It makes the full environment-data chain unusually visible - real-query sourcing, template instantiation, executed multimodal episodes, success/failure retention, whole-trajectory judgment, and step-level training views - while showing why static trajectory availability is not the same as replayable agent training or a verified RL feedback contract.
inclusion_reason: GUI-360° is directly useful to the environment-and-agent-trajectory track because it exposes a concrete multimodal Windows Office episode schema, a hybrid GUI/API action trace, successful and failed rollouts, a whole-trajectory judge, and derived step-level SFT/evaluation objects. Its missing replay stack, judge prompt, provenance controls, and RL contract are equally important audit boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary paper record is arXiv:2511.04307v2, revised on 10 November 2025. OpenReview identifies it as a submission to ICLR 2026; no acceptance decision was verified. This Card also relies on the official GitHub repository at commit a9f9d2e6f125c8cbc176b46a74aeef76ed16f0f6 and the official Hugging Face dataset inspected on 20 July 2026.

GUI-360° addresses a concrete data gap for computer-using agents: converting heterogeneous Office requests into executed, multimodal Windows episodes that retain the state, reasoning, action, environment response, and outcome boundary needed for SFT and evaluation. Its scope is bounded to Word, Excel, and PowerPoint productivity tasks; cross-application, version-management, privacy-, security-, and safety-risk tasks are filtered, so it is not evidence for general desktop deployment.

The canonical raw object is an Office episode composed of JSON step records. Steps in one episode share execution_id, app_domain, request, and template; each step records step_id/total_steps, EvaAgent evaluation reason/evidence/sub-scores/completeness, synchronized screenshots, Windows UI Automation state, application/control metadata, subtask, observation, thought, the executed GUI or MCP-backed Office API action with function, arguments and spatial target, and a CONTINUE, FINISH, or OVERALL_FINISH status. The episode is therefore more than a screenshot-action pair, although the released artifacts do not make it replayable in a pinned VM.

The reported release combines 17,189 successful trajectories and 62,170 separately published failed trajectories, yielding 79,359 trajectories and 1,225,177 steps; Hugging Face shows approximately 574 GB. This makes the work central to environment_agent_trajectory_data, while the query-to-template, collection, filtering, sanitization, split, and packaging pipeline also supports data_construction_open_release_recipes. Paper, appendix, repository, evaluator/converter code, and dataset trees support L4 content depth, but the canonical curation level remains L3_summary_ready and unresolved replay, verifier, split, rights, and privacy facts remain explicit.

首要论文记录为 arXiv:2511.04307v2，修订日期是 2025 年 11 月 10 日。OpenReview 将其标为 ICLR 2026 submission；本卡未核验到 acceptance decision。Card 还核验了官方 GitHub 仓库 commit a9f9d2e6f125c8cbc176b46a74aeef76ed16f0f6，以及 2026 年 7 月 20 日检查的官方 Hugging Face 数据集。

GUI-360° 针对 computer-using agent 的一个具体数据缺口：把来源异构的 Office 请求转化为真实执行的 Windows 多模态 episode，并保留 SFT 与 evaluation 所需的 state、reasoning、action、environment response 和 outcome 边界。其范围限定为 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 生产力任务；cross-application、version-management 以及 privacy/security/safety-risk task 会被过滤，因此它不能证明通用 desktop deployment 的安全性或有效性。

规范的原始对象是由 JSON step record 组成的 Office episode。同一 episode 的 step 共享 execution_id、app_domain、request 与 template；每一步记录 step_id/total_steps、EvaAgent 的 evaluation reason/evidence/sub-score/completeness、同步 screenshot、Windows UI Automation state、application/control metadata、subtask、observation、thought，以及已经执行的 GUI 或 MCP-backed Office API action，包括 function、argument、spatial target 和 CONTINUE、FINISH 或 OVERALL_FINISH status。因此，该对象不只是 screenshot-action pair；但已发布 artifact 尚不足以在固定 VM 中 replay。

论文报告的 release 包含 17,189 条成功轨迹与 62,170 条独立发布的失败轨迹，合计 79,359 条 trajectory、1,225,177 个 step；Hugging Face 显示体量约 574 GB。它因此是 environment_agent_trajectory_data 的核心材料，而 query-to-template、collection、filtering、sanitization、split 与 packaging 管线也对应 data_construction_open_release_recipes。论文、appendix、repository、evaluator/converter code 与 dataset tree 支撑 L4 正文深度，但规范 curation level 仍保持 L3_summary_ready，replay、verifier、split、rights 和 privacy 未知项均明确保留。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
GUI-360° turns real-world Office query patterns into executed Windows trajectories, validates whole episodes with GPT-4.1-based EvaAgent, preserves both successful and failed runs, and derives four step-level SFT-ready views from the same underlying interaction records.

The construction mechanism starts from help/tutorial material, online forums and Q&A/community sites, and search-engine queries. An unspecified LLM matches a query to one of 66 manually instantiated templates—30 Word, 30 Excel, and 6 PowerPoint—and concretizes it. A five-way LLM gate rejects NONEXEC, CROSSAPP, VERCTRL, TPLMISS, and INVALID tasks. TrajAgent then uses a master planner, execution agents, screenshot and accessibility perception, hybrid GUI/MCP actions, and a recorder; GPT-4o makes the first attempt and GPT-4.1 retries failures.

The feedback contract has two non-interchangeable layers. During collection, EvaAgent is a GPT-4.1 LLM-as-judge over the complete trajectory, screenshots, accessibility data, actions, thoughts, and final application state; it stores rationale, evidence, sub-scores, and binary completeness, and the paper reports 86% agreement with humans on 100 sampled trajectories. For released benchmarks, programmatic step scorers instead test point-in-box grounding, greedy IoU/text screen parsing, or exact function/argument/status action prediction. Those scorers observe logged labels, not the consequences of executing a prediction in a live Office environment.

The four processed SFT-ready directories are action prediction, action prediction with accessibility context, grounding, and screen parsing, all described as Qwen2.5-VL-7B-oriented transformations. In the first two, targets are structured next actions; grounding targets coordinates from a screenshot and current-step thought; screen parsing targets actionable controls with names and boxes. These support sft, GUI agent_training, and static evaluation, but do not establish a reusable RL reward or rlvr contract.

The nearest Atlas comparisons are OS-Genesis, OpenCUA, and AndroidControl. GUI-360°'s distinguishing combination is its Windows Office substrate, hybrid GUI/API step schema, whole-trajectory LLM judgment, separately retained failure tree, and multiple derived static views. It does not make GUI agents, accessibility grounding, LLM judging, or SFT individually new; the contribution is the integrated data object and release pipeline at this scale.

GUI-360° 把真实 Office query pattern 转换为已执行的 Windows trajectory，以 GPT-4.1 驱动的 EvaAgent 验证完整 episode，同时保留成功与失败运行，并从同一批 interaction record 派生四类 step-level SFT-ready view。

构造机制从 help/tutorial material、online forum、Q&A/community site 与 search-engine query 开始。一个未披露的 LLM 把 query 匹配到 66 个手工实例化 template 之一——Word 30 个、Excel 30 个、PowerPoint 6 个——再将其具体化。五分类 LLM gate 会拒绝 NONEXEC、CROSSAPP、VERCTRL、TPLMISS 与 INVALID task。随后，TrajAgent 组合 master planner、execution agent、screenshot/accessibility perception、混合 GUI/MCP action 与 recorder；GPT-4o 执行第一次尝试，GPT-4.1 重试失败任务。

反馈契约包含两个不能互换的层次。采集阶段，EvaAgent 是 GPT-4.1 LLM-as-judge，它观察完整 trajectory、screenshot、accessibility data、action、thought 与 final application state，并保存 rationale、evidence、sub-score 与 binary completeness；论文报告它在 100 条抽样 trajectory 上与人工判断的一致率为 86%。发布 benchmark 使用的则是 programmatic step scorer，分别检查 point-in-box grounding、greedy IoU/text screen parsing，或 function/argument/status 的 exact action prediction。这些 scorer 只观察 logged label，不会在 live Office environment 中执行预测并观察后果。

四个 processed SFT-ready directory 分别是 action prediction、带 accessibility context 的 action prediction、grounding 与 screen parsing，均被描述为面向 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的转换。前两类目标是 structured next action；grounding 根据 screenshot 与 current-step thought 预测 coordinate；screen parsing 输出带 name 和 box 的 actionable control。这些对象支持 sft、GUI agent_training 与静态 evaluation，但没有建立可复用 RL reward 或 rlvr contract。

Atlas 中最接近的对照包括 OS-Genesis、OpenCUA 与 AndroidControl。GUI-360° 的区别在于同时组合 Windows Office substrate、混合 GUI/API step schema、whole-trajectory LLM judgment、独立保留的 failure tree 与多种 derived static view。GUI agent、accessibility grounding、LLM judging 或 SFT 本身并非其单独创新点；贡献在于这一规模下集成的数据对象与发布管线。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Source and instantiate tasks. Mine prototypical Word, Excel, and PowerPoint queries from application help/tutorials, online forums/Q&A/community sites, and search queries. Match each query with an unspecified LLM to one of 66 manually instantiated Office templates, then rewrite it as a concrete executable request. Table 2 lists 27,903 Word, 28,552 Excel, and 21,698 PowerPoint raw queries; these sum to 78,153, whereas §3.1 states 79,075 candidates, so the input count is not reconciled.
  2. Filter task feasibility. Use an unspecified LLM to label tasks as NORMAL, NONEXEC, CROSSAPP, VERCTRL, TPLMISS, or INVALID; retain NORMAL. The paper states that 59,553 candidates survive, but prompts, model version, thresholds, human adjudication, deduplication, and stage-wise records are unavailable.
  3. Execute episodes. Run tasks on fifteen Windows 11 VMs with four CPU cores each. TrajAgent decomposes the request, dispatches execution agents, captures screenshots and UI Automation/accessibility state, selects mouse/keyboard GUI actions or Word/Excel/PowerPoint APIs exposed through MCP, records observations, thoughts, action arguments/coordinates, and statuses, and continues until finishing. GPT-4o handles the first execution round; GPT-4.1 retries failed tasks. Both are reported at temperature 0.0.
  4. Judge and sanitize. GPT-4.1-based EvaAgent inspects the full episode and final application state and supplies reason, evidence, sub-scores, and a completion decision. Only successful/executable trajectories satisfying all undisclosed criteria enter the main corpus. Steps without an executed action, screenshot, or essential metadata are removed. The failed attempts remain under a separate HF fail/ tree, but failure taxonomy, timeout/abort policy, attempt-to-task mapping, and sanitizer drop logs are unknown.
  5. Split and transform. Split successful trajectories 80/20 by trajectory into train (13,750 trajectories, 105,368 steps) and GUI-360-Bench/test (3,439 trajectories, 26,284 steps). All three benchmark tasks share this partition. Convert the same logs into four SFT-ready directories: grounding, screen parsing, action prediction, and action prediction with accessibility context.
  6. Train and evaluate. The paper uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B for the principal SFT/action-prediction experiments and also reports a UI-TARS-1.5-7B SFT grounding variant. The processed records support coordinate, structured-control, and structured-next-action targets. Static evaluators compute point-in-box grounding, IoU/text parsing metrics, and function/argument/status matching. They do not replay actions or supply an executable terminal reward.

Reported SFT and stated RL experiments use four NVIDIA A100 40GB GPUs, FP16, gradient accumulation, checkpointing, and a learning-rate search over 1e-5, 5e-6, and 1e-6. Optimizer, batch size, epochs, scheduler, seeds, selected learning rate per run, checkpoint mapping, and all RL algorithm/reward/rollout details are unknown. Reproduction therefore requires pinning the arXiv version, GitHub commit and HF files, plus unavailable Windows/Office/MCP versions, VM image, locale/display, reset rules, TrajAgent/EvaAgent implementation and prompt, terminal checker, task/split IDs, and timeout/retry manifests.

可重建的管线如下：

  1. 来源与任务实例化。 从 application help/tutorial、online forum、Q&A/community site 与 search query 中收集 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 的 prototypical query。使用未披露的 LLM，把每条 query 匹配到 66 个手工实例化 Office template 之一，再改写为具体可执行 request。Table 2 给出 Word 27,903、Excel 28,552、PowerPoint 21,698 条 raw query，合计 78,153；但 §3.1 写的是 79,075 个 candidate，因此输入计数尚未对齐。
  2. 过滤任务可执行性。 未披露的 LLM 把 task 标为 NORMAL、NONEXEC、CROSSAPP、VERCTRL、TPLMISS 或 INVALID，只保留 NORMAL。论文称最终保留 59,553 个 candidate，但 prompt、模型版本、threshold、人工 adjudication、deduplication 与逐阶段记录均未发布。
  3. 执行 episode。 在 15 台 Windows 11 VM 上运行任务，每台分配 4 个 CPU core。TrajAgent 分解 request、调度 execution agent、捕获 screenshot 与 UI Automation/accessibility state，选择 mouse/keyboard GUI action 或通过 MCP 暴露的 Word/Excel/PowerPoint API，并记录 observation、thought、action argument/coordinate 和 status，直至结束。GPT-4o 执行第一轮，GPT-4.1 重试失败任务；二者报告的 temperature 均为 0.0。
  4. 判断与清洗。 GPT-4.1 驱动的 EvaAgent 检查完整 episode 和 final application state，给出 reason、evidence、sub-score 与 completion decision。只有满足全部未披露 criteria 的成功且可执行 trajectory 才进入主 corpus；缺少已执行 action、screenshot 或 essential metadata 的 step 会被删除。失败尝试独立保存在 HF fail/ tree，但 failure taxonomy、timeout/abort policy、attempt-to-task mapping 与 sanitizer drop log 均为 unknown。
  5. 切分与转换。 成功轨迹按 trajectory 做 80/20 切分：train 为 13,750 条 trajectory、105,368 个 step；GUI-360-Bench/test 为 3,439 条 trajectory、26,284 个 step。三类 benchmark task 共用该 partition。随后把日志转换成四个 SFT-ready directory：grounding、screen parsing、action prediction，以及带 accessibility context 的 action prediction。
  6. 训练与评测。 论文以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 为主要 SFT/action-prediction 实验模型，也报告 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 的 SFT grounding variant。processed record 分别提供 coordinate、structured control 和 structured next-action target。静态 evaluator 计算 point-in-box grounding、IoU/text parsing metric 与 function/argument/status matching；它们不 replay action，也不提供 executable terminal reward。

论文报告 SFT 及其所称 RL 实验均使用 4 张 NVIDIA A100 40GB、FP16、gradient accumulation、checkpointing，并在 1e-5、5e-6、1e-6 中搜索 learning rate。optimizer、batch size、epoch、scheduler、seed、每次运行选定的 learning rate、checkpoint mapping，以及所有 RL algorithm/reward/rollout 细节均为 unknown。复现时必须固定 arXiv version、GitHub commit 与 HF file；而 Windows/Office/MCP 版本、VM image、locale/display、reset rule、TrajAgent/EvaAgent implementation 与 prompt、terminal checker、task/split ID 和 timeout/retry manifest 仍未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Release scale is supported by the paper and the official dataset tree. Train contains 13,750 successful trajectories and 105,368 steps; GUI-360-Bench/test contains 3,439 and 26,284. Together these are 17,189 successful trajectories and 131,652 steps. The paper reports another 62,170 failed trajectories and 1,093,525 steps, physically represented by a separate fail/ tree. Adding the reported counts gives 79,359 trajectories and 1,225,177 steps, while Hugging Face reports approximately 574 GB. The complete corpus was not downloaded and independently recounted for this Card.

For grounding, Table 7 reports Qwen2.5-VL-7B improving from 35.78% zero-shot to 82.30% after SFT, and UI-TARS-1.5-7B from 62.27% to 82.49% after SFT. For action prediction, Tables 9–10 report Qwen2.5-VL-7B visual-only step success rising from 17.52% to 50.08%, while visual+A11y rises from 14.18% to 25.78%. The latter remains far below visual-only SFT, so accessibility context is not uniformly beneficial under this setup.

For screen parsing, Table 8 reports OmniParser-v2 at overall F1 0.408 and mean IoU 0.735, compared with the strongest listed general model, o3, at F1 0.128 and mean IoU 0.578. The released code uses greedy one-to-one IoU matching at IoU ≥ 0.5 plus text similarity. Its separate generic per-sample success flag at recall ≥ 0.1 is not the paper's macro F1/IoU result and is not task completion.

EvaAgent's only reported calibration is 86% agreement with human annotators on 100 randomly sampled trajectories. The paper does not provide the human count or qualifications, inter-annotator agreement, confusion matrix, false-positive/false-negative rates, or adversarial robustness. All benchmark numbers above are author-reported static results without uncertainty or independent reproduction. They show that the released SFT views and scorers produce measurable changes; they do not certify record-level data quality, environment replay, or an RL reward contract.

论文与官方 dataset tree 共同支持 release scale。Train 包含 13,750 条成功 trajectory、105,368 个 step；GUI-360-Bench/test 包含 3,439 条 trajectory、26,284 个 step，合计 17,189 条成功 trajectory、131,652 个 step。论文另报 62,170 条失败 trajectory、1,093,525 个 step，官方发布中有独立 fail/ tree。把报告数相加可得 79,359 条 trajectory 与 1,225,177 个 step；Hugging Face 显示体量约 574 GB。本卡没有下载完整 corpus 并独立复点。

Grounding 方面，Table 7 报告 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 从 35.78% zero-shot 提高到 SFT 后的 82.30%，UI-TARS-1.5-7B 从 62.27% 提高到 82.49%。Action prediction 方面，Tables 9–10 报告 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的 visual-only step success 从 17.52% 提高到 50.08%，visual+A11y 从 14.18% 提高到 25.78%。后者仍远低于 visual-only SFT，因此 accessibility context 在该 setup 下并非总是有益。

Screen parsing 方面，Table 8 报告 OmniParser-v2 的 overall F1 为 0.408、mean IoU 为 0.735；所列最强 general model o3 的 F1 为 0.128、mean IoU 为 0.578。发布代码在 IoU ≥ 0.5 时进行 greedy one-to-one matching，并计算 text similarity。代码中另有 recall ≥ 0.1 的通用 per-sample success flag，它不等于论文的 macro F1/IoU，也不表示 task completion。

EvaAgent 唯一报告的 calibration，是在随机抽取的 100 条 trajectory 上与 human annotator 达到 86% 一致率。论文没有给出人工人数或资质、inter-annotator agreement、confusion matrix、false-positive/false-negative rate 或 adversarial robustness。以上 benchmark 数字均是作者报告的静态结果，没有 uncertainty 或 independent reproduction。它们说明发布的 SFT view 与 scorer 能产生可测变化，却不能认证逐记录 data quality、environment replay 或 RL reward contract。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior GUI-agent datasets and benchmarks already contain screenshots, actions, accessibility state, grounding labels, or environment tasks; the related Atlas references are OS-Genesis, OpenCUA, and AndroidControl. GUI-360° does not introduce GUI control, accessibility metadata, LLM-as-judge validation, MCP, or supervised fine-tuning in isolation.

The first concrete change is the released episode object at Windows Office scale: temporally aligned screenshots, UI Automation state, observations, thoughts, GUI or app-API actions, status, and an episode-level evaluation record are linked through execution/task/template identifiers. This exposes both behavior and the judgment attached to it rather than only a final benchmark score.

The second change is failure visibility and multi-view transformation. The 17,189 successful trajectories are accompanied by 62,170 separately released failed trajectories, and the same successful logs are converted into grounding, screen parsing, action prediction, and action prediction+A11y SFT-ready views. Failures are therefore not simply absent from the public artifact, although the release does not supply a complete failure taxonomy, attempt manifest, or reward conversion.

The third change is the end-to-end construction recipe: public query sourcing, manual template instantiation, LLM matching and feasibility filtering, staged GPT-4o/GPT-4.1 execution, GPT-4.1 whole-trajectory judgment, sanitization, split, and packaging. Its direction value for reasoning-data research lies in making state, action, feedback, failure retention, and derived supervision visible in one pipeline. This is an engineering and release integration contribution, not proof that every sample is high quality or that the corpus is replayable.

Before treating the recipe as reusable, a builder must reconcile query counts, recover record-level source/template/attempt lineage, publish the collection and validation stack, pin Windows/Office/MCP and VM/reset configuration, expose immutable split manifests, and resolve third-party content rights and privacy controls. Without those checks, the verified novelty is the static release and its auditable data transformations—not an open environment or RLVR system.

既有 GUI-agent dataset 与 benchmark 已包含 screenshot、action、accessibility state、grounding label 或 environment task；Atlas 中相关参照包括 OS-Genesis、OpenCUA 与 AndroidControl。GUI-360° 并未单独提出 GUI control、accessibility metadata、LLM-as-judge validation、MCP 或 supervised fine-tuning。

第一项具体变化，是在 Windows Office 规模上发布 episode object：通过 execution/task/template identifier，把时间对齐的 screenshot、UI Automation state、observation、thought、GUI 或 app-API action、status 与 episode-level evaluation record 连接起来。由此公开的不只是最终 benchmark score，还包括 behavior 与附着其上的 judgment。

第二项变化是 failure visibility 与 multi-view transformation。17,189 条成功 trajectory 之外，还有 62,170 条独立发布的失败 trajectory；同一批成功日志又被转换成 grounding、screen parsing、action prediction 和 action prediction+A11y 四类 SFT-ready view。因此，公开 artifact 并未简单丢弃失败数据；但 release 没有提供完整 failure taxonomy、attempt manifest 或 reward conversion。

第三项变化是端到端 construction recipe：public query sourcing、手工 template instantiation、LLM matching 与 feasibility filtering、分阶段 GPT-4o/GPT-4.1 execution、GPT-4.1 whole-trajectory judgment、sanitization、split 与 packaging。它对 reasoning-data 研究的方向价值，是在同一管线中同时呈现 state、action、feedback、failure retention 与 derived supervision。这是工程和发布层的集成贡献，不是每条 sample 高质量或 corpus 可 replay 的证明。

把该 recipe 作为可复用方案前，构建者还必须对齐 query count，恢复逐记录 source/template/attempt lineage，发布 collection/validation stack，固定 Windows/Office/MCP 与 VM/reset configuration，公开 immutable split manifest，并解决第三方内容 rights 与 privacy control。完成这些检查前，已核验的新意是 static release 与可审计的数据转换，而不是开放 environment 或 RLVR system。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The official repository does not contain the dedicated TrajAgent collection implementation, EvaAgent validation implementation or prompt/rubric, VM provisioning, Office/MCP version manifests, state reset scripts, timeout rules, or an executable terminal-state checker. Static logs and scorers therefore do not provide faithful environment replay.
  • EvaAgent is a single GPT-4.1 judge calibrated only by a reported 86% human agreement on 100 trajectories. Missing confusion matrices, error rates, rubric criteria, disagreement handling, and adversarial tests leave both false acceptance and false rejection unresolved; access to generated thoughts may also let persuasive text influence judgment without environment proof.
  • The successful corpus uses an 80/20 trajectory split over only 66 template families. No immutable IDs, grouping key, seed, template/source-family separation, deduplication, or contamination audit is disclosed, so train/benchmark overlap through templates, paraphrases, source queries, or similar UI states remains plausible.
  • Table 2's application counts sum to 78,153, while §3.1 states 79,075 candidates, and the filtering percentages do not transparently reproduce 59,553 retained tasks. Exact source URLs, terms, crawl dates, per-record provenance, and rejected-query manifests are unavailable.
  • Failure retention is substantial but incomplete as an audit object. The fail/ tree contains 62,170 reported trajectories, yet failure types, retry/timeout/abort rules, whether all failed attempts are preserved, links to source tasks, and sanitizer drop logs are unknown.
  • The paper mentions reinforcement learning, but no RL objective, reward, policy, rollout budget, isolated result table, or training code is released. Failed trajectories must not be treated as an SFT-free RLVR dataset or a ready reward contract.
  • The paper documents four screenshot variants, while the current HF card documents only clean and annotated fields. GitHub and HF lack immutable whole-release tags, the HF viewer currently fails, and exact file/checkpoint mappings for paper tables are absent; schema and version drift must be pinned manually.
  • GitHub code is MIT, and HF metadata declares MIT, but those declarations do not resolve rights for crawled query text, Microsoft Office screenshots/templates, fonts, icons, or other third-party UI content. The authors state that no PII or sensitive user data is included, but source URLs, consent/terms analysis, PII detector, redaction procedure, audit sample, and retention policy are not released.

• 官方仓库不包含专用 TrajAgent collection implementation、EvaAgent validation implementation 或 prompt/rubric，也没有 VM provisioning、Office/MCP version manifest、state reset script、timeout rule 或 executable terminal-state checker。因此，静态日志与 scorer 不能提供 faithful environment replay。
  • EvaAgent 是单一 GPT-4.1 judge，校准证据只有在 100 条 trajectory 上报告的 86% 人工一致率。缺少 confusion matrix、error rate、rubric criterion、disagreement handling 与 adversarial test，使 false acceptance 和 false rejection 都未解决；它还能读取生成的 thought，具有说服力的文本可能在没有 environment proof 时影响判断。
  • 成功 corpus 在仅 66 个 template family 上按 trajectory 做 80/20 split。没有披露 immutable ID、grouping key、seed、template/source-family separation、deduplication 或 contamination audit，因此通过 template、paraphrase、source query 或相似 UI state 发生 train/benchmark overlap 仍属 plausible risk。
  • Table 2 的应用计数合计 78,153，但 §3.1 写的是 79,075 个 candidate；已发布过滤比例也无法透明复现 59,553 个 retained task。精确 source URL、terms、crawl date、逐记录 provenance 与 rejected-query manifest 均未提供。
  • Failure retention 规模可观，但作为 audit object 仍不完整。fail/ tree 包含论文报告的 62,170 条 trajectory，但 failure type、retry/timeout/abort rule、是否保留全部 failed attempt、与 source task 的链接，以及 sanitizer drop log 都是 unknown。
  • 论文提到 reinforcement learning，却没有发布 RL objective、reward、policy、rollout budget、独立 result table 或 training code。失败 trajectory 不应被当作无需进一步转换的 RLVR dataset 或现成 reward contract。
  • 论文记录四种 screenshot variant，而当前 HF card 只记录 clean 与 annotated field。GitHub/HF 没有 immutable whole-release tag，HF viewer 当前失败，论文 table 也缺少精确 file/checkpoint mapping；schema 与 version drift 必须手工固定。
  • GitHub code 使用 MIT，HF metadata 也声明 MIT，但这些声明不能解决 crawled query text、Microsoft Office screenshot/template、font、icon 或其他第三方 UI content 的 rights。作者称数据不含 PII 或 sensitive user data，但 source URL、consent/terms analysis、PII detector、redaction procedure、audit sample 与 retention policy 均未发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, GUI-360° provides a concrete Windows Office episode schema for studying multimodal agent behavior: request/template provenance, screenshots, accessibility state, reasoning, GUI/API action arguments and coordinates, statuses, and episode judgment. The separately published failures make it possible to compare successful and unsuccessful behavior, but users should first reconstruct attempt lineage and failure categories rather than treating every failed run as a uniform negative.

For data_construction_open_release_recipes, the paper offers an auditable baseline pipeline: source queries, instantiate template-bound tasks, apply feasibility labels, execute two model stages, judge whole trajectories, sanitize incomplete steps, split successes, preserve failures, and convert logs into task-specific training views. Reimplementations should explicitly version every hidden component that the official repository omits: query prompts, TrajAgent, EvaAgent prompt/rubric, VM/Office/MCP stack, reset and timeout policy, and terminal predicate.

The four processed views can support SFT baselines and ablations for coordinate grounding, screen parsing, visual-only next-action prediction, and next-action prediction with accessibility context. The released scorers can support static evaluation and verifier audits: point-in-box label noise, IoU/text matching sensitivity, action parser errors, alternative-action false negatives, accessibility metadata drift, and the gap between a logged step match and end-to-end task success.

Reuse class: usable for sft, GUI agent_training through supervised next-action/grounding objectives, and static evaluation, provided users pin files and address license, privacy, split, and provenance constraints. It is blocked for faithful VM replay, executable environment training, and RL reproduction. The abstract-level RL mention and released failures do not justify adding rlvr without an explicit reward, objective, rollout protocol, results, and code.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，GUI-360° 提供了一个具体的 Windows Office episode schema，可用于研究 multimodal agent behavior：request/template provenance、screenshot、accessibility state、reasoning、GUI/API action argument 与 coordinate、status，以及 episode judgment。独立发布的 failure 可用于比较成功与失败 behavior，但使用者应先重建 attempt lineage 与 failure category，不能把所有失败运行当成同质 negative。

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 而言，论文给出一条可审计 baseline pipeline：获取 source query、实例化 template-bound task、应用 feasibility label、执行两个 model stage、对完整 trajectory 做 judgment、清洗不完整 step、切分成功数据、保留失败数据，再把日志转换成 task-specific training view。复现者应为官方仓库缺失的每个组件显式固定版本：query prompt、TrajAgent、EvaAgent prompt/rubric、VM/Office/MCP stack、reset/timeout policy 与 terminal predicate。

四类 processed view 可支持 coordinate grounding、screen parsing、visual-only next-action prediction，以及带 accessibility context 的 next-action prediction 的 SFT baseline 与 ablation。发布 scorer 可用于静态 evaluation 和 verifier audit，包括 point-in-box label noise、IoU/text matching sensitivity、action parser error、alternative-action false negative、accessibility metadata drift，以及 logged step match 与 end-to-end task success 之间的差距。

复用等级：在固定 file 并处理 license、privacy、split 与 provenance 约束后，可用于 sft、通过监督式 next-action/grounding objective 进行 GUI agent_training，以及静态 evaluation。faithful VM replay、executable environment training 与 RL reproduction 仍受阻。只有 abstract-level RL 表述和已发布 failure，不足以在缺少显式 reward、objective、rollout protocol、result 与 code 时加入 rlvr。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3 and Appendix B first to map one Office episode: shared request/template identifiers, synchronized visual and accessibility state, textual observation/thought, hybrid GUI/API action, status, and EvaAgent evaluation fields.
  • Keep three boundaries separate: EvaAgent's whole-trajectory GPT-4.1 judgment, the released static step scorers, and an executable terminal-state verifier. Only the first two are documented; the third is absent.
  • Remember the scale decomposition: 17,189 successful plus 62,170 failed equals 79,359 trajectories, with 1,225,177 total steps and an approximately 574 GB release.
  • Inspect Tables 7–10 together: SFT improves reported grounding and action-prediction scores, but visual+A11y action prediction remains below visual-only SFT, and none of these static scores certifies data quality or replay.
  • Pin GitHub commit a9f9d2e6f125c8cbc176b46a74aeef76ed16f0f6 and the HF files, then audit query-count conflicts, split/template leakage, failure lineage, EvaAgent errors, third-party UI rights, and privacy controls before reuse.

• 优先阅读 §3 与 Appendix B，先画清一条 Office episode：共享的 request/template identifier、同步 visual/accessibility state、文本 observation/thought、混合 GUI/API action、status 与 EvaAgent evaluation field。
  • 区分三个边界：EvaAgent 的 whole-trajectory GPT-4.1 judgment、已发布的 static step scorer，以及 executable terminal-state verifier。只有前两者有文档，第三者缺失。
  • 记住规模拆分：17,189 条成功 trajectory 加 62,170 条失败 trajectory，等于 79,359 条 trajectory；总计 1,225,177 个 step，release 约 574 GB。
  • 联合查看 Tables 7–10：SFT 提高了报告的 grounding 和 action-prediction score，但 visual+A11y action prediction 仍低于 visual-only SFT；这些静态分数都不能认证 data quality 或 replay。
  • 复用前固定 GitHub commit a9f9d2e6f125c8cbc176b46a74aeef76ed16f0f6 与 HF file，并审计 query-count conflict、split/template leakage、failure lineage、EvaAgent error、第三方 UI rights 与 privacy control。
